obligations.statement: \forall Owners::state s; \forall integer frontier,r; Owners::valid(s,frontier) && Owners::active_owner(s,r) && Owners::buffer(s,r) == 0 ==> Owners::valid(Owners::bind(s,r,frontier),frontier+1) && Owners::buffer(Owners::bind(s,r,frontier),r) == frontier

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer frontier,destination,source; Owners::valid(s,frontier) && Owners::active_owner(s,destination) && Owners::active_owner(s,source) && destination != source && Owners::buffer(s,destination) == 0 ==> Owners::valid(Owners::move(s,destination,source),frontier) && Owners::buffer(Owners::move(s,destination,source),destination) == Owners::buffer(s,source) && Owners::buffer(Owners::move(s,destination,source),source) == 0

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer destination,source,q; q != destination && q != source ==> (Owners::active_owner(Owners::move(s,destination,source),q) <==> Owners::active_owner(s,q)) && Owners::buffer(Owners::move(s,destination,source),q) == Owners::buffer(s,q)

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer frontier,left,right; Owners::valid(s,frontier) && Owners::active_owner(s,left) && Owners::active_owner(s,right) ==> Owners::valid(Owners::swap(s,left,right),frontier) && Owners::buffer(Owners::swap(s,left,right),left) == Owners::buffer(s,right) && Owners::buffer(Owners::swap(s,left,right),right) == Owners::buffer(s,left)

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer left,right,q; q != left && q != right ==> (Owners::active_owner(Owners::swap(s,left,right),q) <==> Owners::active_owner(s,q)) && Owners::buffer(Owners::swap(s,left,right),q) == Owners::buffer(s,q)
\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer r; Owners::swap(s,r,r) == s

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer frontier,r,q; Owners::valid(s,frontier) && Owners::active_owner(s,r) && q != r ==> Owners::valid(Owners::retire(s,r),frontier) && !Owners::active_owner(Owners::retire(s,r),r) && Owners::buffer(Owners::retire(s,r),r) == 0 && (Owners::active_owner(Owners::retire(s,r),q) <==> Owners::active_owner(s,q)) && Owners::buffer(Owners::retire(s,r),q) == Owners::buffer(s,q) && (Owners::active_owner(s,q) && Owners::buffer(s,r) != 0 ==> Owners::buffer(s,q) != Owners::buffer(s,r) && q != Owners::buffer(s,r))

\forall Owners::state s; \forall integer r,q; Owners::active_owner(s,r) && Owners::active_owner(s,q) && r != q && Owners::buffer(s,r) != 0 && Owners::buffer(s,r) == Owners::buffer(s,q) ==> !Owners::exclusive(s)

constructive_consistency.limitation: Finite examples exhibit satisfiable antecedents and the intended unrestricted integer/map model; they do not prove universal goals or source/Heap correspondence. Zero generated smoke goals supply no empirical consistency or body reachability evidence. Standard theory/driver/solver soundness and source-to-runtime correspondence remain explicit TCB.
constructive_consistency.model: Integers are ordinary unbounded integers; maps are total mathematical functions; state is the product (Int->Bool)x(Int->Int). Owners adds only total definitions, no axioms/lemmas/goals. empty uses constant false/zero maps. Set updates and every transition are total, hence the Owners extension has this concrete model relative to standard Int/Map support.

support_boundary: Only exact complete non-goal assertion hashes with prior primary-source attribution. No prior goals, outcomes, proofs, project Heap claims or sibling ownership duties are imported as premises; unknown current assertions remain unresolved.
